synthesis: Shared real-AY controls, exact continuous prefix reuse

chip_fit.tone_harmonics: odd 1/h through 31, below 0.48 sample rate, actual integer AY periods
chip_fit.limitations: Estimated fundamentals and noise; AY Boolean mixer shares one volume with the tone and cannot add an independently controlled fourth voice. No listening acceptance implied.
chip_fit.channel_assignment: pitch continuity, 2-semitone gate; amplitude rank never changes channel

noise_colour_fit.model: Ayumi continuous AY-3-8910 spectral noise fit v2
noise_colour_fit.objective: mean of three log-magnitude MAE values after narrow 50-Hz power smoothing; source-relative -60 dB floor
noise_colour_fit.resampling: 127-tap Hann/sinc, cutoff 10584 Hz, zero-phase then decimate by two
noise_colour_fit.limitations: Candidate streams have continuous phase; the chosen sequence has a different LFSR history. Final rendering and independent emulator validation are required. No analogue circuit or source-separation accuracy claim.

automatic_mixer_fit.analytic_shared_level: noise N; mixed (4*T+sqrt(2)*N)/3, quantized to chip DAC
automatic_mixer_fit.limitations: Analytic shortlist can miss the 374-candidate optimum; final unpooled full-render fallback guards the seed. No perceptual fidelity claim.

input_normalization.method: selected-interval sample-peak calibration with bounded smooth dynamics

simulation_feedback.objective: mean absolute masked log-spectral MAE for 512/2048/8192 + 0.35 * 20-ms RMS log-MAE; fixed calibration

psychoacoustic.limitations: Tunable approximation of critical bands, simultaneous and short forward masking; no standard compliance or listening-quality guarantee.

simulation_feedback.limitations: Bounded local proposals, not a global optimum; three channels cannot reproduce arbitrary PCM. Playback SPL and analogue circuit response are unknown.

necessary_noise.necessity: 3-field mean of complete tone-only minus noise-enabled perceptual error
necessary_noise.limitations: Conservative audibility policy requested after listening; ordinary spectral error can increase when weak residual noise is omitted. Not perfect source separation.

hardware_envelope.limitations: One shared nonlinear DAC envelope: 16 AY or 32 YM level codes. Bounded proposals and coarse frequency grid; not an ideal triangle or independent channel envelopes.

final_feedback.objective: mean absolute masked log-spectral MAE for 512/2048/8192 + 0.35 * 20-ms RMS log-MAE; fixed calibration

psychoacoustic.limitations: Tunable approximation of critical bands, simultaneous and short forward masking; no standard compliance or listening-quality guarantee.

final_feedback.limitations: Bounded local proposals, not a global optimum; three channels cannot reproduce arbitrary PCM. Playback SPL and analogue circuit response are unknown.

chip_fit.player_timing_note: AY12 resident fields add 192 T without shape restart, 232 T with restart; movie IRQ remains 367+83*n T and AYH2 decoding adds three register checks.
chip_fit.scope: Exact leading controls from continuous original PCM fit; same processed reference and fixed output calibration. No recomputed partial-fit claim.
